action: A helicopter starts in a large close-up hovering in place, then pulls back and tilts nose-down as it flies away to the right and gets smaller toward the horizon.
identity_gap: The body outline, curled tail tip, cockpit window line and three-line rotor all match the doodle. In frames 4 to 6 the rotor mast is drawn as a long diagonal line that cuts down through the cabin, and in frame 4 the mast is doubled, which the doodle never does.
notes: Frames 1 to 3 hold steady and frames 6 to 8 shrink smoothly, but frame 4 changes scale and tilt abruptly with a doubled mast and the skid line crossing the struts at a new angle. Keeping the rotor mast a short vertical stub fixed to the cabin roof in every frame, as in the doodle, would help most.
